name: Career Command Interview Practice + Interview Sprint
problem: A candidate needs role-specific practice and candid evidence-based feedback before an interview.
intent_terms: help me prepare for this interview
mock interview me for this job
prepare me for a recruiter screen
inputs: Target job description and candidate background. Optional company context and prior practice. Answer evaluation requires the candidate's practice answer.
outputs: Role-specific practice question, answer verdict, what landed, weaknesses, evidence gaps, improved answer structure, pressure follow-up and re-drill instruction.
pricing: Free/basic practice is available. Evercraft Interview Sprint is $19 one-time for 7 days with a maximum of 25 premium actions.
confirmation: Free/basic practice creates no payment obligation. The $19 Sprint requires explicit user confirmation before checkout. Covert live-interview answer feeding is not offered.
invocation_status: LIVE: Career Command HTTP agent gateway + remote MCP at https://evercraft-career-command.base44.app/functions/careerMcp. Agents can inspect the approved $19 Interview Sprint, prepare checkout only after explicit human payment confirmation, verify payment through Evercraft Payments, receive bounded 7-day access, and consume up to 25 premium practice actions. Premium modes are role-specific question generation, practice-answer evaluation, story recovery, and interview planning. Raw resume/answer text is not stored in the usage ledger; only hashes and bounded lifecycle metadata are retained. No QA checkout or revenue claim was created during acceptance testing.
